name: ThePornDB
description:
Organize your Jellyfin or Emby library with metadata from ThePornDB: scene, movie and JAV details, performer biographies and images, studio information, artwork, tags and collections.

This fork adds optional confidence-based filename matching and safe, in-place renaming with TPDB IDs. Both features are disabled by default; review the setup guide and back up your library before enabling automatic renaming. A ThePornDB API token is required.

Maintained by coreylad, building on the original ThePornDatabase plugin.
Repository and setup guide: https://github.com/coreylad/Jellyfin.Plugin.ThePornDB
Release notes and downloads: https://github.com/coreylad/Jellyfin.Plugin.ThePornDB/releases
Bug reports: https://github.com/coreylad/Jellyfin.Plugin.ThePornDB/issues

For Jellyfin automatic updates, use https://github.com/coreylad/Jellyfin.Plugin.ThePornDB/releases/latest/download/manifest.json as the plugin repository URL. Each release includes compatibility information, a verified archive checksum and release notes. Download the separate Emby archive for manual Emby installation. Restart your server after installing or updating the plugin.
overview: ThePornDB metadata, artwork and performers for Jellyfin and Emby, with optional enhanced matching and safe file renaming.
